_note: Malay. Written separately from Indonesian, because the diff said the pair is close
but not derivable: 34 of 402 prose cells identical at 0.86 mean similarity, and
only 3 of the 134 example sentences.
The ratio is not what settles it - the SHAPE of the difference is. Every word-level
substitution between the two files comes to 338 substitutions in 277 distinct
types, which is a long tail rather than a rule set. pt/pt_BR was derivable because
its difference was nine rules applied over and over. Here the ten recurring pairs
(adalah/ialah, tak/tidak, dari/daripada, setelah/selepas, bisa/boleh, film/filem,
kritikus/pengkritik, baru/baharu, tim/pasukan, publik/awam) cover well under a
fifth of it, and the rest is a different word almost every row.
So the headwords were chosen for Malay rather than carried across from the
Indonesian: plumb-line is tali sipat where Indonesian took unting-unting,
peculation is penyelewengan against penggelapan, seneschal is ketua istana against
kepala rumah tangga, mortised is puting-dan-lubang against pen-dan-lubang, and
nugatory is tidak sah against tak berlaku. A locale written next to its finished
sibling drifts into the sibling - az drifted into Turkish in this same session -
so each row was decided from the English, with the Indonesian only as a check that
the sense had not moved.
The seven specimen quotations stay English. Reported speech was already Malay.
'Doomscrolling' stays because it IS the specimen of a new coinage, and 'who' /
'whom' stays because it is an English distinction Malay lacks.
english_ok is mathesis alone. dint kept the English preposition 'by dint of'
bodily inside the sentence, the same fault id, kk and ky had.

glosses.escutcheon: Perisai lambang keluarga itu masih tergantung di atas pintu depan rumah bangsawan lama.
glosses.superannuated: Pencetak usang itu akhirnya diganti selepas lima belas tahun tersekat.
glosses.succedanea: Doktor zaman perang sering bergantung kepada ubat ganti apabila ubat yang sepatutnya habis.

friendly.euphonious: Sekadar enak didengar — kata, nama, atau ayat yang merdu mengalir di telinga hampir seperti muzik.
friendly.fiducial: Sesuatu yang anda terima secara percaya lalu jadikan sauh — tanda rujukan ialah titik tetap yang segala-galanya diukur daripadanya.
friendly.ineluctable: Pasti berlaku apa pun yang anda lakukan — tiada ruang menggeliat keluar daripada hasil yang tidak dapat dielakkan.
friendly.minatory: Membawa aura ancaman yang tidak silap — tatapan atau surat yang mengancam membuat sangat jelas sesuatu yang buruk mungkin menyusul.
friendly.mordant: Kecerdasan yang ada gigi — komen pedas sedikit menusuk justru kerana sasarannya begitu cermat.
friendly.nugatory: Pada dasarnya tidak berharga — klausa yang tidak sah dalam kontrak ialah yang sebenarnya tidak melakukan apa-apa.
friendly.redound: Apabila pujian (atau celaan) terpantul kembali kepada orang yang bertanggungjawab — amal baik yang kembali kepada nama baik akan berpusing membalas anda.
friendly.trenchant: Menyayat omongan kosong — komen atau minda yang tajam sampai ke jantung isu dengan pantas, tanpa kata yang terbuang.
